title: Core actions are hidden without the shared core permission
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • A test customer exists.
  • A test vendor exists to order parts from.
  • The part sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way).
  • The part sale has the part "Water Pump" (Quantity 1; Vendor = the test vendor; Sell Price $517.55; Core Charge $79.99) and, beneath it, a row "Core for Water Pump".
  • The part has been authorized, ordered and received: the part row reads Received and its core row offers Return Core in the Actions column.
  • The service work order: a service work order for the same customer with a received core (a part with Vendor = the test vendor and a Core Charge of $79.99).
  • User X is a spare test user with the role "ZZAUTOTEST Parts no core" (built from a template, for example "Parts Manager"): Part sales - Create & Edit ticked; every box under Vendor and order management (vendors, purchase orders, deliveries and part returns) unticked; Work order lines - Create & Edit and Work orders - Create & Edit unticked.
  • User Y is a spare test user with the role "ZZAUTOTEST No financial data" (built from a template, for example "Parts Manager"): See Financial Data (under Cross-Cutting) unticked.
  • The sale and the work order are built while signed in as an Owner/Admin user.

title: Only part sales created after release charge the core from the quote
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • The pre-release sale: a part sale started BEFORE the release with a core (created before the Founder Mode release reached this build, for example dated Sep 30, 2026 or earlier), whose parts list shows a "Core for ..." row.
  • The newly-created sale: a NEW part sale seeded now for the customer with the part "Water Pump" (Quantity 1, Vendor = a test vendor, Sell Price $517.55, Core Charge $79.99), not Authorized or Ordered.
  • A sale you can split and two part sales you can move a line between.

title: Moving a charged core to a work order is not available yet
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A test customer exists.
  • A test vendor exists to order parts from.
  • The part sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way).
  • The part sale has the part "Water Pump" (Quantity 1; Vendor = the test vendor; Sell Price $517.55; Core Charge $79.99) and, beneath it, a row "Core for Water Pump".
  • The part has been authorized, ordered and received: the part row reads Received and its core row offers Return Core in the Actions column.
  • A service work order for the same customer to move the part onto, with a line.

title: Core rows sync to QuickBooks under the core part's category item
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit and Invoicing & payments - Create & Edit).
  • A test customer exists.
  • QuickBooks Online is connected to this shop (the QuickBooks test company).
  • The core's part category (the category the part uses, "Uncategorized" if none was chosen) is mapped to a QuickBooks item (for example "Parts").
  • A test vendor exists to order parts from.
  • The first sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way), with the part "Water Pump" (Quantity 1; Vendor = the test vendor; Sell Price $517.55; Core Charge $79.99) and, beneath it, a row "Core for Water Pump".
  • On the first sale the part is authorized, ordered and received, and the core has been returned: the core row's Status reads Returned, and the document on the Finance tab has a Core credit row of -$79.99.
  • The second sale (for the unmapped check): built exactly like the first, but with the part's Category set to "ZZAUTOTEST No QuickBooks item", a category whose QuickBooks Products And Services is empty; it is ordered, received and its core returned too.

title: A fee or discount on a returned core comes to $0
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Owner/Admin user (that role holds every permission, including Part sales - Create & Edit).
  • A customer to sell to exists.
  • A part sale created on or after the release, carrying a part (for example "Water Pump", Quantity 1, Vendor = a test vendor, Sell Price for example $517.55) with a Core Charge greater than 0 (for example $79.99); a "Core for ..." row appears beneath the part.
  • The part is authorized, ordered and received, so Return Core is available on the core row.
  • A per-item fee or discount is added while the core is charged (for example a flat $5 fee).

title: Edit tax rate locks once invoiced, unlocks on reversal, needs permission
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • A test customer exists.
  • A test vendor exists to order parts from.
  • The invoiced sale: a new part sale started today for the test customer (a sale started before this release handles cores the old way), with the part "Brake Pads" (Quantity 1, Vendor = the test vendor, Sell Price $290.91).
  • The part is ordered and received, so the sale is Complete.
  • The sale has been invoiced and paid in full, and that payment then reversed: the sale stays Invoiced, with no payment applied.
  • Two tax rates exist (for example a second one, "ZZAUTOTEST 6%" at 6.00%).
  • The user without the permission: a spare test user with the role "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit" (built from a template, for example "Parts Manager"): Part sales - Create & Edit unticked, Part sales View left ticked.

title: Part Sale Log needs permission and shows only this part sale

  • The user without the permission: a test user WITHOUT Part sales - Create & Edit (role "ZZAUTOTEST No part sale edit", built from a template, for example "Parts Manager", with Part sales View left ticked).
  • A second part sale, and a service work order with one change made on it, so both have entries that must never appear in this part sale's log.

A shop with online payments off (ShopPay turned off) would also do, but on this QA build no ShopPay switch was found under Settings.

title: Adding a note needs View permission on that kind of record
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • A work order at this location (customer for example "4 Star Truck Repair").
  • A part sale at this location.
  • User C: a second teammate, with the role "ZZAUTOTEST Work orders only" (built from the "Service Advisor" template; Work orders - View ticked, Part sales - View unticked).
  • For tagging or group membership only, any staff member (for example "Ashlee Thomas") can be User C.

title: Only the author edits a note, deleting needs authorship or Delete
new_pre_body:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Owner/Admin user (the standard Admin role). This is User A.
  • A work order at this location (customer for example "4 Star Truck Repair").
  • A part sale at this location.
  • User A has written one note on each: the work order, the part sale and the customer.
  • User B: a teammate at the same location who can sign in, with the role "ZZAUTOTEST WO delete" (built from the "Service Advisor" template; Work orders - Delete ticked, Part sales - Delete and Customers - Delete unticked).
  • User C: a second teammate, with the role "ZZAUTOTEST PS and customer delete" (built from the "Service Advisor" template; Part sales - Delete and Customers - Delete ticked, Work orders - Delete unticked).
  • For tagging or group membership only, any staff member (for example "Ashlee Thomas") can be User C.
  • User D: a teammate with neither role and none of those Delete permissions.
  • For the last step: a work order note written by the customer in the Customer Portal, and a system note (one the app wrote itself). If the work order has neither, mark step 5 Blocked and write why.
